result.instructions: Tools for Emailchef, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "How many active contacts are in each of my Emailchef lists?"; "Which campaigns did I send last month and how many people opened each?"; "Add anna@example.com to my Newsletter list.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Emailchef data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run emailchef_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run emailchef_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run emailchef_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. emailchef_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: emailchef_get_account
tools.title: Get account
tools.description: The Emailchef account this API key belongs to: id, email, language, status, subscriber total, bounces and complaints. GET /accounts/current.

tools.name: emailchef_get_subscription
tools.title: Get subscription
tools.description: The account's current Emailchef plan: plan name, plan expiry, contact and send limits, credits left, active/expired flags. Check this before a big send. GET /subscriptions/current.

tools.name: emailchef_list_senders
tools.title: List senders
tools.description: List the sender identities (name, email, verification status, postal address). Campaigns and emails need a verified sender id. GET /senders.

tools.name: emailchef_list_timezones
tools.title: List timezones
tools.description: List Emailchef's timezones (id, name, fixed UTC offset). The id is required to schedule a campaign. GET /meta/timezones.

tools.name: emailchef_list_lists
tools.title: List contact lists
tools.description: List the contact lists with id, name, and counts of active, unsubscribed and bounced contacts and segments. Newest first by default. GET /lists.

order_by.description: Sort by creation date (default) or name.

offset.description: Rows to skip (default 0). Pass the previous reply's next_offset.

tools.name: emailchef_get_list
tools.title: Get list
tools.description: One contact list: name, description, default sender, creation date. GET /lists/{list_id}.

list_id.description: Numeric id (as returned by the list tools).

tools.name: emailchef_get_list_stats
tools.title: Get list growth stats
tools.description: Daily growth of a list over a date range: total contacts per day and the daily delta. Omit the dates for the whole history. GET /lists/{list_id}/stats.

list_id.description: Numeric id (as returned by the list tools).

tools.name: emailchef_get_list_contact_counts
tools.title: Get list contact counts
tools.description: How many contacts a list has by state: active, unsubscribed, bounced, reported. GET /lists/{list_id}/stats/count.

list_id.description: Numeric id (as returned by the list tools).

tools.name: emailchef_create_list
tools.title: Create list
tools.description: WRITE: create a new, empty contact list. Returns the new list id. POST /lists.

tools.name: emailchef_update_list
tools.title: Update list
tools.description: WRITE: rename a contact list and/or change its description. Only the fields you pass change. PUT /lists/{list_id}.

list_id.description: Numeric id (as returned by the list tools).

tools.name: emailchef_list_contacts
tools.title: List contacts
tools.description: List the contacts of one list (id, email, name, added by, subscription date), optionally by state. GET /contacts?list_id=...

list_id.description: Numeric id (as returned by the list tools).

status.description: Only contacts in this state (default: all).

offset.description: Rows to skip (default 0). Pass the previous reply's next_offset.

tools.name: emailchef_get_contact
tools.title: Get contact
tools.description: One contact in one list: status, email, name, IP, how it was added, when, and its custom field values. GET /contacts/{contact_id}?list_id=...

list_id.description: Numeric id (as returned by the list tools).

contact_id.description: Numeric id (as returned by the list tools).

tools.name: emailchef_create_contact
tools.title: Add contact to a list
tools.description: WRITE: add a contact (email, name, custom fields) to a list. Only add people who agreed to receive email: an ACTIVE contact will receive the account's campaigns and automations. Returns the contact id and status. POST /contacts.

list_id.description: Numeric id (as returned by the list tools).

status.description: Initial state (default: the account's default, normally ACTIVE).

custom_fields.description: Custom field values keyed by the field's place_holder (see emailchef_list_custom_fields): a string, or true/false for boolean fields.

tools.name: emailchef_update_contact
tools.title: Update contact
tools.description: WRITE: change a contact's name, state or custom fields in one list. Only the fields you pass change. Setting the status to ACTIVE re-subscribes someone: only do so with their consent. PUT /contacts/{contact_id}.

list_id.description: Numeric id (as returned by the list tools).

contact_id.description: Numeric id (as returned by the list tools).

custom_fields.description: Custom field values keyed by the field's place_holder (see emailchef_list_custom_fields): a string, or true/false for boolean fields.

tools.name: emailchef_unsubscribe_contact
tools.title: Unsubscribe contact
tools.description: WRITE: unsubscribe one contact from one list (it stops receiving that list's email). POST /lists/{list_id}/unsubscribe?contact_id=...

list_id.description: Numeric id (as returned by the list tools).

contact_id.description: Numeric id (as returned by the list tools).

tools.name: emailchef_import_contacts
tools.title: Import contacts
tools.description: WRITE: bulk-add or update up to 500 contacts in a list in one call (an existing email is updated). Each contact is an object keyed by field placeholder, e.g. {"email":"a@b.com","firstname":"Ada"}: get the placeholders from emailchef_list_predefined_fields and emailchef_list_custom_fields. Import only people who agreed to receive email. Runs in the background: poll emailchef_get_import_task with the returned id. POST /lists/{list_id}/import.

list_id.description: Numeric id (as returned by the list tools).

contacts.description: Contacts to import, each keyed by placeholder.

tools.name: emailchef_list_import_tasks
tools.title: List import tasks
tools.description: List contact import tasks: list, status (DISPATCHED, COMPLETE, FAILED), progress, imported/updated/failed counts. GET /importtasks.

tools.name: emailchef_get_import_task
tools.title: Get import task
tools.description: One import task: status, progress, imported/updated/failed counts and any error message. GET /importtasks/{task_id}.

task_id.description: Numeric id (as returned by the list tools).

tools.name: emailchef_list_predefined_fields
tools.title: List predefined fields
tools.description: The built-in contact fields (email, first name, ...) with their placeholders. GET /predefinedfields.

tools.name: emailchef_list_custom_fields
tools.title: List custom fields
tools.description: The custom contact fields of a list: name, data type, placeholder (the key used when writing contacts), options. GET /lists/{list_id}/customfields.

list_id.description: Numeric id (as returned by the list tools).

tools.name: emailchef_list_segments
tools.title: List segments
tools.description: List the saved segments of a list with how many contacts match each. GET /lists/{list_id}/segments.

list_id.description: Numeric id (as returned by the list tools).

offset.description: Rows to skip (default 0). Pass the previous reply's next_offset.

tools.name: emailchef_get_segment
tools.title: Get segment
tools.description: One segment with its logic and condition groups. GET /lists/{list_id}/segments/{segment_id}.

list_id.description: Numeric id (as returned by the list tools).

segment_id.description: Numeric id (as returned by the list tools).

tools.name: emailchef_list_blocked
tools.title: List blocked emails
tools.description: List the account's blocklist (emails that never receive email): address and reason (MANUAL, UNSUBSCRIBED, COMPLAINT). GET /blockings.

offset.description: Rows to skip (default 0). Pass the previous reply's next_offset.

tools.name: emailchef_block_emails
tools.title: Block emails
tools.description: WRITE: add up to 100 addresses to the account blocklist so they never receive email from any list. Reversible with emailchef_unblock_email. POST /blockings?type=MANUAL.

tools.name: emailchef_unblock_email
tools.title: Unblock email
tools.description: WRITE: remove one address from the account blocklist so it can receive email again. Only do this for an address whose owner asked for it. DELETE /blockings/{email}.

tools.name: emailchef_get_campaign_counts
tools.title: Get campaign counts
tools.description: How many campaigns the account has by state: drafts, sent, scheduled, archived, failed. GET /campaigns/count.

tools.name: emailchef_list_campaigns
tools.title: List campaigns
tools.description: List email campaigns with state, recipients, delivered, unique opens and unique clicks. Without a status filter Emailchef returns only SENT and ARCHIVED campaigns; pass a status to see DRAFT, SCHEDULED, SENDING or FAILED ones. GET /campaigns.

status.description: Only campaigns in this state (default: SENT and ARCHIVED).

search.description: Only campaigns whose name contains this text.

offset.description: Rows to skip (default 0). Pass the previous reply's next_offset.

tools.name: emailchef_get_campaign
tools.title: Get campaign
tools.description: One campaign: name, subject, HTML and text body, sender, reply-to, state, schedule, recipient lists/segments and cached sent/open/click counts. GET /campaigns/{id}.

campaign_id.description: Numeric id (as returned by the list tools).

tools.name: emailchef_get_campaign_links
tools.title: Get campaign links
tools.description: The links contained in a campaign (id, name, URL). GET /newsletters/{id}/links.

campaign_id.description: Numeric id (as returned by the list tools).

tools.name: emailchef_list_campaign_engagement
tools.title: List campaign engagement
tools.description: Per-contact engagement for a sent campaign: who opened, clicked, was delivered, did not open, unsubscribed, complained, or was sent to, with counts and first/last event time. Pick exactly one event. GET /newsletters/{id}/contacts.

campaign_id.description: Numeric id (as returned by the list tools).

search.description: Only contacts whose email or name contains this text.

offset.description: Rows to skip (default 0). Pass the previous reply's next_offset.

tools.name: emailchef_create_campaign
tools.title: Create campaign (draft)
tools.description: WRITE: create a new campaign as a DRAFT (nothing is sent). Needs a verified sender (emailchef_list_senders) and at least one list. To be sendable the HTML body must contain the CAN-SPAM placeholders [[account:business]], [[account:address_1]], [[account:city]], [[account:postal_code]], [[account:country]] and an unsubscribe link <a href="[[unsubscribe_link]]">, otherwise the send ends FAILED. Schedule or send it afterwards. POST /newsletters.

name.description: Campaign name (must be unique in the account).

sender_id.description: A verified sender id from emailchef_list_senders.

items.description: Numeric id (as returned by the list tools).

segment_id.description: Optional segment of the FIRST list to narrow the audience.

html_body.description: HTML body (include the CAN-SPAM placeholders and unsubscribe link).

tools.name: emailchef_clone_campaign
tools.title: Clone campaign
tools.description: WRITE: copy an existing campaign into a new DRAFT (nothing is sent). A SENT campaign cannot be cloned (Emailchef answers HTTP 500). Returns the new campaign id. POST /newsletters?clone=1.

tools.name: emailchef_update_campaign
tools.title: Update draft campaign
tools.description: WRITE: change a DRAFT campaign's name, subject, body, sender, reply-to or recipient lists. Only the fields you pass change: the tool reads the campaign first and sends the complete record back, because Emailchef blanks any omitted field. Refuses a campaign that is not a DRAFT. PUT /newsletters/{id}.

campaign_id.description: Numeric id (as returned by the list tools).

sender_id.description: Numeric id (as returned by the list tools).

reply_to_id.description: Numeric id (as returned by the list tools).

list_ids.description: Replace the recipient lists (any segment is dropped unless segment_id is also passed).

items.description: Numeric id (as returned by the list tools).

segment_id.description: Segment of the first list (only with list_ids).

tools.name: emailchef_send_test_campaign
tools.title: Send campaign test email
tools.description: WRITE: email ONE test copy of a campaign to a single address. The campaign state does not change. The sender must be verified. PUT /campaigns/{id}/sendtest.

campaign_id.description: Numeric id (as returned by the list tools).

email.description: Where to send the test copy.

tools.name: emailchef_schedule_campaign
tools.title: Schedule campaign
tools.description: WRITE, SENDS EMAIL TO CUSTOMERS LATER: schedule a DRAFT campaign to go out to all its recipients at a date and time. Emailchef timezones are fixed offsets without daylight saving: pick the id (emailchef_list_timezones) whose offset matches the send date. Undo before it starts with emailchef_unschedule_campaign. PUT /campaigns/{id}/schedule.

campaign_id.description: Numeric id (as returned by the list tools).

scheduled_time.description: Local send time in the chosen timezone, YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS (no UTC offset or Z).

tools.name: emailchef_unschedule_campaign
tools.title: Unschedule campaign
tools.description: WRITE: cancel the schedule of a SCHEDULED campaign and bring it back to DRAFT. PUT /campaigns/{id}/unschedule.

campaign_id.description: Numeric id (as returned by the list tools).

tools.name: emailchef_send_campaign
tools.title: Send campaign now
tools.description: WRITE, SENDS EMAIL TO CUSTOMERS NOW AND CANNOT BE UNDONE: start sending a DRAFT (or FAILED) campaign immediately to ALL its recipients and use up plan sends. Check the recipients (emailchef_get_campaign), the sender and the subscription first, ideally after emailchef_send_test_campaign, and send only with the user's explicit go-ahead (confirm must be true). Queued asynchronously: poll emailchef_get_campaign for the final state. PUT /campaigns/{id}/send.

campaign_id.description: Numeric id (as returned by the list tools).

confirm.description: Must be true: the user explicitly approved sending this campaign now.

tools.name: emailchef_archive_campaign
tools.title: Archive campaign
tools.description: WRITE: archive a campaign (hidden from the default list; statistics are kept). Reversible with emailchef_unarchive_campaign. PUT /campaigns/{id}/archivecampaign.

campaign_id.description: Numeric id (as returned by the list tools).

tools.name: emailchef_unarchive_campaign
tools.title: Restore archived campaign
tools.description: WRITE: restore an archived campaign. PUT /campaigns/{id}/unarchivecampaign.

campaign_id.description: Numeric id (as returned by the list tools).

tools.name: emailchef_send_email
tools.title: Send one email
tools.description: WRITE, SENDS AN EMAIL NOW AND CANNOT BE UNDONE: send a single email to one recipient from a verified sender and use up plan sends. Pass text_body and/or html_body. The recipient does not need to be a contact. Send only with the user's explicit go-ahead (confirm must be true). POST /sendmail.

sender_id.description: A verified sender id from emailchef_list_senders.

confirm.description: Must be true: the user explicitly approved sending this email now.

tools.name: emailchef_get_sms_balance
tools.title: Get SMS balance
tools.description: The account's SMS credit balance and currency. GET /sms/balance.

tools.name: emailchef_get_sms_status
tools.title: Get SMS status
tools.description: Delivery status of one sent SMS by message id: recipient, text, sent/done time, parts, price, state and error. GET /sms/status/{messageId}.

tools.name: emailchef_send_sms
tools.title: Send SMS
tools.description: WRITE, SENDS TEXT MESSAGES NOW, COSTS SMS CREDIT AND CANNOT BE UNDONE: send an SMS to 1-50 phone numbers in international format (e.g. +393331234567). Check emailchef_get_sms_balance first and send only with the user's explicit go-ahead (confirm must be true). Returns a message id per recipient and the remaining balance. POST /sms/send.

from.description: Sender name or number (default: the account's).

confirm.description: Must be true: the user explicitly approved sending these SMS now.

prompts.name: getting_started
prompts.title: Get started with Emailchef
prompts.description: What you can do with Emailchef here, with example requests to try.

prompts.name: count_the_active_contacts_in_each_list
prompts.title: Count the active contacts in each list
prompts.description: List your contact lists with the counts of active, unsubscribed and bounced contacts. Open one list to see its growth by day.

prompts.name: review_how_last_month_s_campaigns_performed
prompts.title: Review how last month's campaigns performed
prompts.description: List the campaigns you sent. Read the links in one campaign and the engagement of its recipients to see who opened and clicked.

prompts.name: add_a_new_subscriber_to_a_list
prompts.title: Add a new subscriber to a list
prompts.description: Create a contact from the details of a new lead and add it to your Newsletter list. Update the contact later when its details change.

prompts.name: copy_a_draft_campaign_and_schedule_it
prompts.title: Copy a draft campaign and schedule it
prompts.description: Clone an existing draft campaign into a new draft. Read the timezones and the verified senders, then schedule the new draft for a day and time.

prompts.name: check_sending_limits_before_a_big_send
prompts.title: Check sending limits before a big send
prompts.description: Read the send limits and the credits left of the account. Check the SMS balance before you plan a text message to your customers.
